decisions.reason: Management is likely to continue backing this naval lighting line because it fits the firm's specialist robust-lighting competence, carries certification and development sunk costs, and any slower uptake can still be justified as normal for long project cycles.

Although less central than building-system solutions, the dedicated launch visibility and invested design effort make management inclined to persist and interpret any weak traction as a temporary market-positioning issue rather than a reason to withdraw.
This interior luminaire remains close to the firm's core applications business, so prior launch commitment and the ease of framing results as part of a normal rollout strongly favor continuation.
Because the firm publicly framed this pendant luminaire as a flagship for its direction, strategic centrality and reputational commitment make withdrawal very unlikely within the next year.

Even after pruning another marine searchlight line, management is likely to retain this HMI searchlight because it still fits the firm's specialist niche capabilities and disappointing results can be attributed to uneven project demand rather than product failure.
